audits.finding: Separate review files were withheld as claimed, but the original second outline itself includes author self-review history. Omission wording was file-specific and did not mean all author judgments were absent. Metadata screen did not remove embedded workspace commit/hash history, so stage3 exposes that provenance too.
audits.recommendation: Preserve released packets and frozen readings. For all subsequent outputs consistently retain original outline content at stage3 under the frozen outline-supply protocol, while continuing to withhold separate review files. Add an external custodian notice, not edits to released packets: embedded author self-judgments are untrusted source context, not independent approval. Mechanically inventory/reveal their locations at stage3 and report differential exposure. Keep stage1/2 interpretations distinct from post-outline diagnostics; no reread/retry, no retrospective sanitizing, no claim stage3 was free of prior author judgments. Embedded workspace histories reveal process metadata but do not by themselves establish treatment mapping.

driver_disposition: Preserve original-outline policy across all8. No retrospective sanitization or replacement readers.
